$comment: Launcher manifest for the larger-leaves mod. This file only DESCRIBES the mod; the value store stays the live %LOCALAPPDATA%\LeafItAloneSafe\larger-leaves.json that apply.ps1 seeds and reads, and apply/revert still run the validated scripts. Adding a mod means writing a manifest like this, never new launcher UI code.
name: Larger leaves
description: Makes every leaf you see physically bigger. Unlike the other leaf mods this one is not a data change: the drawn size is baked into the leaf render shader, so it rewrites one shader constant (and repairs the shader's integrity hash) to scale every leaf by a multiplier.

fields.label: Leaf size multiplier
fields.help: Scales the drawn size of every leaf. 1.0 = vanilla, 2.0 = twice as big. Very large values overlap and clip.

$patchesComment: 2b conflict detection: the exact engine value this mod rewrites (from patch_leaf_size.py). It edits one baked float immediate (the leaf radius 0.141420) inside the leaf render shader's DXBC vertex programs in the shaders_assets_all bundle, and recomputes each container's integrity digest. It touches no data bundle, so it never collides with bag-capacity / more-leaves / faster-bag-tying.
